name: PNAS (pnas-new class)
description: PNAS research article on the real pnas-new class (v1.44, LPPL, shipped with the bundle): two-column, 9pt, natbib numeric. The Significance Statement renders in the blue box on page 1; Acknowledgments / Author Contributions / Materials & Methods can go to PNAS end-matter via the section-style catalog. Draft watermark disabled.

special_sections.label: Significance Statement
special_sections.hint: Max ~120 words for a broad readership — renders in the blue box on page 1.

special_sections.label: Author Contributions
special_sections.hint: Prints in the first-page fact box.

special_sections.label: Materials and Methods (PNAS end-matter)
special_sections.hint: Text-only (figures cannot live inside the macro) — keep an inline Methods section if it carries floats.

layout.notes: PNAS: 8.7 cm single / 11.4 cm 1.5-col / 17.8 cm double; two-column; floats top or own page.

look.name: PNAS (pnas-new class page)
look.measured_from: pnas-new.cls v1.44: 8.125x10.875 in layout on US Letter, hoffset 0.1875 in, voffset 0.0625 in, odd-page margins (geometry from the class; sizes from a compile)
look.units_note: sizes are the class's TeX points converted to bp (1pt = 72/72.27 bp)
look.glue_note: inter-word stretch/shrink as fractions of the space, from the class fonts' TFM fontdimens (phv*8t); lmr9 is TeX's 1/2, 1/3 (the default)
look.front_note: front skips are TeX skips (baseline distance = skip + the next baselineskip), measured from a pnas-new compile
